predicate.label: outnumbers
predicate.definition: Group X has a larger number of members or counted units than group Y in an explicitly stated context.
includes: a stated numerical comparison establishing a larger count
historical counts in a particular population
excludes: electoral victory or political control without numerical comparison
score or performance comparison not counting group members
ambiguous: unclear counted population or ordered groups
a truncated comparison that omits what is counted
predicate.notes: This concerns a stated population and time; it does not imply universal or permanent numerical superiority.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit outnumber relation; a stated numerical comparison establishing a larger count; historical counts in a particular population. Excludes: electoral victory or political control without numerical comparison; generic superiority or strength; score or performance comparison not counting group members. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear counted population or ordered groups; a truncated comparison that omits what is counted. This concerns a stated population and time; it does not imply universal or permanent numerical superiority.

rationale: Outnumber is the dominant repeated predicate for political group sizes; national corporate descriptors and office location are unrelated.
